source: coordinator order 2026-10-24 (Alfredo approved); text literal, do not edit
rule: each sentence shows at least max(2.5 s, words/2 + 0.8 s); one at a time, 0.4 s of empty band between two; the run moves on only after the sentence is done

phrases.text: One real run of my experiment. The ticket: rename two fields in the order event.
Two other teams read these fields. The agent cannot see those teams.
The code agent works on the orders team. The other teams are behind the glass.
Now the agent reads the code and changes the two names.
The tests in its own repo are green. It opens a pull request.
CI is the only reviewer. It runs ten checks.
Red. Rule ARCH-4: another team needs the old field.

phrases.moment: before Meanwhile: the camera goes behind the glass
phrases.text: Now look behind the glass, at the tests of the other teams.
Billing fails. Analytics fails. Billing cannot send the invoice.
The agent never sees these tests.

phrases.moment: before the red build reaches the agent
phrases.text: What goes back to the agent is only the red build.
The agent reads the message from CI, and fixes the code.
It keeps the old names as aliases, next to the new ones.
It sends the fix. CI runs again.
Before the repair: CI said no, and two teams broke. After: every team is green.
The agent did not need a meeting. It needed a red build.
